sentences.text: Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Class
**Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to provide financial aid to promote education. Scholarships are provided to eligible students of Standards 1 to 10.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Scholarships and student finance

**Detailed Description:** The scheme "Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Class" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to promote education among socially and educationally backwards students. Through this scheme, scholarships per annum are provided to boys and girls studying in Standards 1 to 10 in government and aided schools. The scheme is implemented by the Director, Developing Caste Welfare, Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

**Benefits / Assistance:** 1. **For Boys (Std. 1 to 8):** ₹750/- scholarship.1. **For Boys (Std. 9 to 10):** ₹1000/- scholarship.1. **For Girls (Std. 1 to 5):** ₹500/- scholarship.1. **For Girls (Std. 6 to 10):** ₹1000/- scholarship.

**Application Process:** > **How to Register:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Digital Gujarat](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) portal. **Step 2:** The user should click on the &quot;Click to register&quot; option. Fill in all details and click on &quot;Save&quot;. > **How to Log In:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Digital Gujarat](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) portal. **Step 2:** The user should click on the &quot;Login&quot; option. **Step 3:** Enter all details and click on &quot;Login&quot;. > **How to Apply for a New Service:** **Step 1:** After logging in, select the relevant department. **Step 2**: Choose the specific service to apply for within that department. **Step 3:** Fill out all required details in the application form. **Step 4:** Upload, attach, or browse necessary documents. Alternatively, import documents directly from DigiLocker. **Step 5:** Carefully review all entered information. **Step 6:** Submit the application. **Step 7:** Once the application is completed, proceed to payment to download the certificate. **Step 8:** Upon successful payment, the certificate will be available for download. &gt; **Digital Gujarat (Help Desk):** Contact No: 18002335500
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Director, Developing Caste Welfare, Gandhinagar, Gujarat; Nodal Department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department
**Tags:** Backward Class, Primary School Students, Secondary School Students, Financial Assistance, Scholarship
